$comment: Pinned build toolchain for the OpenMana Forge engine. engine/scripts/setup-toolchain.sh downloads and verifies the archives and builds GraalVM CE with Web Image from the pinned open sources (no Oracle GraalVM package, Prompt 35; docs/research/OPEN_WEB_IMAGE_BUILD_2026-10-09.md). Change only in a dedicated toolchain PR (docs/research/FORGE_BUILD.md §3, §6).

graalvm.distribution: GraalVM Community Edition with Web Image, built from source with mx on labsjdk-ce (no Oracle GraalVM package)
graalvm.license: GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 (substratevm, web-image, compiler, espresso-shared); UPL-1.0 (sdk)

jdk.distribution: labsjdk-ce (OpenJDK with JVMCI, built by the GraalVM project)
jdk.licenseEvidence: legal/*/LICENSE in the archive: 69 identical files, SHA-256 4b9abebc4338048a7c2dc184e9f800deb349366bdf28eb23c2677a77b4c87726 (GPLv2 text with the Classpath exception); no file names the Oracle No-Fee Terms (NFTC) or the GraalVM Free Terms (GFTC)
jdk.checksumSource: GitHub release asset digest of graalvm/labs-openjdk jvmci-25.4-b23; matches the download (2026-10-09).

binaryen.checksumSource: binaryen-version_123-x86_64-linux.tar.gz.sha256 published on the GitHub release; matches the download.
